newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN shares lower after truck profit warning.
newsitem.headline: MAN shares lower after truck profit warning.

text.p: Shares in the German engineering group MAN AG fell nearly four percent in mid-session bourse trade on Thursday after a profit warning in its truck division.

Shares in MAN AG stood at 385 marks mid-bourse, down 15.80 marks or 3.94 percent, after it said it expected a clear decline in 1996/97 earnings, a six-percent drop in sales and a 10-percent decline in output in its truck unit.
The overall DAX-30 index was down 15.52 points, or 0.57 percent, at 2,684.01 points.
